Special Council Meeting

Thursday, February 19, 2026 - 02:30 PM

A Special Meeting of Council will be held at 2.30pm Thursday 19 February 2026. The purpose is for council to consider submission of a Crown Land Enquiry Form for the possible future purchase of Lot 151 (8 Honour Ave) Wyalkatchem. 

View Meeting Details

Annual Electors Meeting

Thursday, February 12, 2026 - 06:00 PM

The Annual Electors' Meeting will be at 6pm Thursday 12 February 2026. The meeting will be held in the Shire of Wyalkatchem Council Chambers 27 Flint Street Wyalkatchem and the public is welcome. The purpose of the meeting is to receive the 2024/25 Annual Report and any general business.  Electors are asked to email questions ahead of the meeting to enable answers to be prepared - questions may also be asked from the floor.  Please send questions to general@wyalkatchem.wa.gov.au

An agenda for the meeting including the annual report is available to view at the public library, the shire administration or on the shire website (please go to Council / Council Meetings).

View Meeting Details

Special Meeting of Council 12 February 2026

Thursday, February 12, 2026 - 05:00 PM

A Special Meeting of Council will occur at 5pm Thursday 12 February 2026.  The meeting will consider the resignation of the Acting CEO, the receipt of a Town Action Plan and an application for a business grant.

The public are welcome to attend.

The annual electros meeting will follow at 6pm.
